items.text: Christine stared at the bread mixture in the bowl. <break time="0.8s" /> Ugh, This is not working. <break time="0.8s" /> Christine shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> She wanted to bake some bread. <break time="0.8s" /> But the mixture would not rise. <break time="0.8s" /> She checked the recipe again. <break time="0.8s" /> But did not know what went wrong. <break time="0.8s" /> Christine sighed loudly. <break time="0.8s" /> And pushed the bowl away. <break time="0.8s" /> Why will this not work. <break time="0.8s" /> She said with a frown. <break time="0.8s" /> Seeing her struggle. <break time="0.8s" /> Christines father offered some advice. <break time="0.8s" /> Try adding a little more baking powder. <break time="0.8s" /> He suggested. <break time="0.8s" /> Christine followed his advice. <break time="0.8s" /> And added another spoonful. <break time="0.8s" /> After only a few minutes. <break time="0.8s" /> The mixture began to rise. <break time="0.8s" /> Christines eyes widened. <break time="0.8s" /> And her heart began pounding. <break time="0.8s" /> It finally works. <break time="0.8s" /> She exclaimed. <break time="0.8s" /> Christine eagerly poured the mixture into a pan. <break time="0.8s" /> And placed it in the oven. <break time="0.8s" /> This bread will be delicious.
